answer_1.quote: We collect a dataset of 2,970 human-written referring expressions grounded in 1,485 generated scenes. We evaluate several recent vision-and-language models on the tasks of referring expression generation and comprehension...
datasets: A new dataset comprising 27,504 sampled scenes, and 2,970 human-written referring expressions grounded in 1,485 generated scenes
answer_1.outputs: referring expressions (descriptions of target object locations)

answer_2.quote: communicative success is achieved when the listener selects the intended target... Our main metric is communicative success: for each scene, did the pair of agents successfully coordinate on the target referent?

answer_4.quote: We recruit crowdworkers to participate in the task both as listeners and speakers... For each referring expression, we acquire three human listener selections and compare the majority class referent to the intended target.
answer_4.guideline: Listeners are presented with the scene and a referring expression and are asked to click on the referent they believe to be the target in the image.
criteria: correctness (whether the listener selects the intended target)
